name: Israel, Gaza and the West Bank

status.en: 124 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, most of them in Gaza, Jerusalem and Hebron.
status.nb: 124 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, flest i Gaza, Jerusalem og Hebron.

summary.en: Israeli settlers attacked Palestinian olive harvesters across the West Bank, wounding three, while Israeli forces demolished homes of Palestinians accused of a Hebron shooting and also razed homes of gunmen linked to that attack, deepening displacement. The UN rights office warned of a deepening displacement nightmare in Gaza and called for an urgent UN protection force to be deployed to Palestine. Al Jazeera released rare footage of Mohammed Deif and documents from October 7, and aired unseen videos of Hamas commanders who have since been killed by Israel. A Swiss TV commentary on Israel’s Olympic bobsleigh team was judged discriminatory. 21,440 battle-related deaths occurred in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Israelske bosettere angrep palestinske olivenplukkere på Vestbredden, og såret tre, mens israelske styrker rev ned hjem til palestinere som er anklaget for en skyting i Hebron og også rev ned hjem til skytevåpenbrukere knyttet til den angrepet, noe som forsterker fordrivelsen. FN-s rettskontor advarte om en dypere fordrivelsesmareritt i Gaza og oppfordret til at en hastig FN-beskyttelsesstyrke blir utplassert til Palestina. Al Jazeera publiserte sjeldent opptak av Mohammed Deif og dokumenter fra 7. oktober, og viste usette videoer av Hamas-kommandanter som siden har blitt drept av Israel. En sveitsisk TV-kommentar om Israels olympiske bobsløyteam ble vurdert som diskriminerende. 21 440 dødsfall knyttet til kamper fant sted i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Gaza war
background.extract: The Gaza war is an armed conflict in the Gaza Strip and Israel, fought as part of the unresolved Israeli–Palestinian and Gaza–Israel conflicts. The war began on 7 October 2023, when Palestinian militant group Hamas led an attack on Israel, in which 1,195 Israelis and foreign nationals were killed and 251 were taken hostage. Since the start of the Israeli offensive that followed, over 74,000 Palestinians in Gaza have been killed; several studies in The Lancet indicate this figure is likely a significant undercount. Many scholarly sources and international organizations—including UN bodies, NGOs, and the International Association of Genocide Scholars—have concluded that Israel's actions in Gaza constitute genocide under international law. Several countries have also stated that genocide is occurring and have supported legal proceedings before the International Court of Justice. Israel and its supporters have denied that genocide has occurred.
background.extractNb: Krigen i Gaza er en krig mellom Israel og væpnede palestinske grupper, hovedsakelig Hamas, som har pågått på Gazastripen og i det sørlige Israel siden 7. oktober 2023. Konflikten er en del av den uløste Israel–Palestina-konflikten, og følger etter krigene i 2008–2009, 2014 og 2021.
